description: Deep-dive into a symbol: type info, source code, callers (top 10), references (count + top 5 files), and test caller count in one call. Use when you need full context about a symbol before editing. Accepts file_path + line/column or position_pattern.

column.description: 1-indexed column (character offset) in the line. Optional when position_pattern is provided.

file_path.description: Absolute path to the source file

language_id.description: Language identifier (e.g. go\, typescript\, python). Optional; auto-detected from file extension

line.description: 1-indexed line number in the file. Optional when position_pattern is provided.

position_pattern.description: Alternative to line/column: use @@pattern@@ syntax to match text near the target position

name: explore_symbol
